description: This file contains extension methods for HttpClient to facilitate sending HTTP requests with JSON payloads, including PATCH, PUT, and POST methods, with support for JSON serialization options.

classes.name: HttpRequestExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for HttpClient to perform JSON-based HTTP requests.

methods.name: PatchAsJsonAsync
methods.description: Sends a PATCH request with a JSON-serialized body.

methods.name: PatchAsync
methods.description: Sends a PATCH request with specified HttpContent.

methods.name: PutAsJsonAsync
methods.description: Sends a PUT request with a JSON-serialized body.

methods.name: PostAsJsonAsync
methods.description: Sends a POST request with a JSON-serialized body and Accept header.

methods.name: PostJsonAsync
methods.description: Sends a POST request with raw JSON string as body and Accept header.

methods.name: PostJsonApiAsync
methods.description: Sends a POST request with JSON API media type as body and Accept header.
